spans.s: भोज [bhōja], a. Bestowing enjoyment; राजा भोजो विराट् सम्राट् क्षत्रियो भूपतिर्नृपः
Leading a life of enjoyment, enjoying; देवासुरमनुष्येषु ये भजन्त्यशिवं शिवम् । प्रायस्ते धनिनो भोजाः

भोजः [bhōjḥ], [भुज्-अच्] N. of a celebrated king of Mālvā (or Dhārā); (supposed to have flourished about the end of the tenth or the beginning of the eleventh century, and to have been a great patron of Sanskṛit learning; he is also supposed to have been the author of several learned works, such as सरस्वतीकण्ठाभरण &c.).
N. of a king of the Vidarbhas; भोजेन दूतो रघवे विसृष्टः
;7.18,29,35. -जाः (m. pl.) N. of a people. -Comp. -अधिपः an epithet of
Karṇa. -इन्द्रः a king of the Bhojas.-कटम् N. of a town founded by Rukmin. -कुलम् the dynasty of the Bhojas who ruled over the country of Vidarbha or Berar; अभोजयद् भोजकुलाङ्कुरः क्वचित्
.-देवः, -राजः king Bhoja; धन्यः श्रीभोजराजस्त्रिभुवनविजयी Udb; see (1) above.
Causing to eat, feeding, nourishing; दैवे पित्र्ये च भोजकः
नम् Eating, eating food; taking one's meals; अजीर्णे भोजनं विषम्.
That which is enjoyed; सहानुजैः प्रत्यवरुद्ध- भोजनः
Property, wealth, possessions.-Comp. -अधिकारः charge of provender, superintendence over food or provisions, stewardship. -आच्छादनम् food and raiment; भोजनाच्छादने दद्यादृतुकाले च संगमम्

.-कालः, -वेला, -समयः meal-time, dinner or supper time. -त्यागः abstaining from food, fasting. -माण्डम् a dish of meat. -भूमिः f. a dining-hall. -विशेषः a dainty, delicacy. -वृत्तिः f. a meal, food. -व्यग्र a.
straitened for want of food.-व्ययः expense for food.
भोजयितृ [bhōjayitṛ], a. [भुज्-णिच्-तृच्] One who feeds, a feeder.
भोजिन् [bhōjin], a. [भुज्-णिनि] (At the end of comp.)
ज्यम् Food, meal; त्वं भोक्ता अहं च भोज्यभूतः
A store of provisions, eatables; वर्धयेद्बाहुयुद्धार्थं भोज्यैः शारीर- केवलम् Śukra.4.877.
Wounding the mortal spot (मर्मभेद); भोज्ये पांसुविकर्षणे
A festive dinner, feast. -Comp. -अन्न a. one whose food may be eaten; एते शूद्रेषु भोज्यान्नाः
. -उष्ण a. too hot to be eaten. -कालः meal-time. -संभवः chyme, the primary juice of the body.
भोज्या [bhōjyā], 1 A princess of the Bhojas; पूर्वानुशिष्टां निजगाद भोज्याम्
